Partly built

Hyrox training group

A goal with a window will find your training partners, open a group room and bring in a coach on a split bill.

Partly built. Some of the steps below exist today and the rest are still to come. The lists at the bottom show which.

How it runs

  1. GoalYou no tool neededSet a goal: train for Hyrox, with a window and a place band.
  2. PlanThe match via deterministic matchFinds people with a matching goal, window and area, by rules rather than guesses.
  3. PlanThe group room via person outsideBrings in a coach from the service bank; the fee splits across the group.
  4. ReceiptAttendance via a personAttendance is the proof; a published race result can confirm the outcome.
What you get
Starts withA person with a goal
StatusPartly built
Sessions attended, the split bill, and a result on each member's profile.

What it keeps to

  • Distance is shown as a band, never a location.
  • Both sides consent before a match is shown.
  • Money moves only on an accepted split.
